{{Quote|Why do we always get the lousy ops?|Flak, complaining about the mission on Juma 9|<ref name="RH" />}}
'''Flak''' was the adopted name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Flak participated in an [[Battle of Juma 9|attempt to recapture]] the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Juma 9]]. Serving with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]], and another [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], Flak received orders from [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to repair a group of condensators outside the station. Although they encountered heavy [[Droid/Legends|droid]] resistance, the group was able to repair the condensators and restore the energy inside Juma 9.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Cut the chatter, Flak. You'll get your chance soon enough.|Commander Ponds, to Flak|<ref name="RH" />}}
[[File:Juma_9.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Juma 9, the space station where Flak fought]]
Flak was the chosen name<ref name="RH" /> of one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]<ref name="SWE" /> of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> who were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> and trained to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Juma 9]] was [[Battle of Juma 9|attacked]] and captured by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], who were on the station during the attack, went missing. Flak, along with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commanders]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]], went on a mission to search for the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and recapture Juma 9. While Fisto and Windu went inside the station, Flak and the other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] patrolled outside of the station, using [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to move in [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="RH" />

During the clones' patrol, Windu contacted them via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and ordered them to repair a group of energy condensators. While engaging several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], and [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|crab droids]], the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] managed to reconnect the electrical wiring of several consoles and restore the station's energy. Before they could repair the final consoles, however, Flak and the others were attacked by a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] and [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|spider droids]]. After defeating the enemy [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]], the Republic clones repaired the last two consoles and informed Windu of their success. Sometime later, the clones found two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] drifting in space and reported this as well. Eventually, the Republic forces were able to rescue Kenobi and Koon, and retake Juma 9.<ref name="RH" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You should learn to enjoy the peace and quiet while you can, Private.''"<br />"''I want to scrap some clankers.|Cody and Flak|<ref name="RH" />}}
Flak was not pleased with what he believed was an unspectacular mission to Juma 9 due to its distance from the war's main action. He complained about the task in front of his superior [[Officer/Legends|officers]], as he preferred to spend his [[Time/Legends|time]] fighting on the front lines, destroying droids.<ref name="RH" /> Like all clones of Jango Fett,<ref name="clone troopers" /> Flak was [[Gender/Legends|male]] and stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" />

==Equipment==
Flak used [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]], a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]], and a jetpack during the fight on Juma 9.<ref name="RH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flak's first appearance was in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''. In the game, he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="RH" />
